title: [BUG] Gradients are summed instead of averaged when using gradient accumulation steps with pipeline parallelism
author: tdrussell

comments.author: tdrussell
comments.body:
Here is a minimal script that reproduces the issue: https://gist.github.com/tdrussell/a848a03f125bbe14d76c555d0d3f9a59

Output:
```
deepspeed --num_gpus=1 deepspeed_gas_bug.py --bs 128 --gas 1
```
steps: 1 loss: 0.3261 iter time (s): 0.199 samples/sec: 641.743
Grad norm: 3.4111355480874153
steps: 2 loss: 0.3389 iter time (s): 0.003 samples/sec: 47626.420
Grad norm: 3.480790320806196
steps: 3 loss: 0.2807 iter time (s): 0.002 samples/sec: 68239.590
Grad norm: 3.165752555980085
steps: 4 loss: 0.2681 iter time (s): 0.002 samples/sec: 70857.912
Grad norm: 3.0587000477883244
steps: 5 loss: 0.3357 iter time (s): 0.002 samples/sec: 66653.334
Grad norm: 3.564681441134813

```
deepspeed --num_gpus=1 deepspeed_gas_bug.py --bs 32 --gas 4
```
steps: 1 loss: 0.2881 iter time (s): 0.200 samples/sec: 641.282
Grad norm: 13.036201201403596
steps: 2 loss: 0.3292 iter time (s): 0.004 samples/sec: 33447.334
Grad norm: 13.98913990761539
steps: 3 loss: 0.3404 iter time (s): 0.003 samples/sec: 39408.478
Grad norm: 13.823161154583502
steps: 4 loss: 0.3789 iter time (s): 0.003 samples/sec: 39903.833
Grad norm: 14.99074135513952
steps: 5 loss: 0.3328 iter time (s): 0.003 samples/sec: 40012.804
Grad norm: 13.549405672998114

Same global batch size but grad norm is 4 times higher in the second case.

comments.author: tdrussell
comments.body:
I am using Deepspeed 0.18.2. This issue is fixed starting with 0.18.3, I am seeing the correct gradients with that version. #7665 appears to be the PR that fixed it. I had other problems upgrading my application to the latest Deepspeed versions, but I guess I will try again so I can pull in the fix.

I don't see any issues about this or mentions of the fix in the changelog, so I'll leave this issue open for visibility. Feel free to close if you feel like this has been fully addressed.

comments.author: tohtana
comments.body:
Hi @tdrussell,
Yes, we had a bug related to gradient accumulation, which is now resolved. I’ll close this issue for now, but please feel free to open a new issue or reopen this one if needed.
